description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool harness for KronoLatch deterministic trip orchestration, anti-phishing ticket domain verification, and group expense debt reduction.

tools.name: verify_vendor_url
tools.description: Audits a candidate ticket or transit booking URL against canonical root domains (Wikidata P856 and Google Places websiteUri) to block SEO phishing clones and reseller markups.

candidate_url.description: The booking link found on Google Search or an aggregator

venue_name.description: Name of the monument, attraction, or transit operator (e.g. 'Colosseum', 'Louvre', 'Trenitalia')

official_domain.description: Optional ground-truth root domain if known

candidate_price.description: Quoted ticket price on the candidate site

tools.name: validate_temporal_dag
tools.description: Validates an itinerary's temporal DAG, computes mode-specific transition buffers (flights 120m, rail 15m), propagates domino delays, and identifies hard conflicts at locked fixed reservations.

nodes.description: List of itinerary stops conforming to trip-dag.schema.json

hub_overhead_minutes.description: Default station queue and platform navigation buffer

injected_delays.description: Map of node_id to delay in minutes to stress-test downstream connections

tools.name: settle_group_expenses
tools.description: Computes net balances across multi-currency expenses (supporting asymmetric subgroup shares) and calculates the minimum number of peer-to-peer settlement transfers.

expenses.description: List of expense records with payer, amount, currency, and participants
